logistics.format: Web-based proctored, open-book reference (ProctorU or PearsonVUE)

recommended_certs.rationale: 攻撃側の GWAPT を経由してから GWEB の防御側深度へ進むと、開発者・防御者ペルソナとしての立体感が増す。

plus.note: AppSec ディフェンダー向けのニッチで、競合する第三者資格が少ない。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 1, professional: 2. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Accredited defensive-development coverage supports professional application-control decisions consistent with the recorded hint; a two-year profile and open-book assessment limit evidence of advanced implementation leadership.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Accredited defensive application-security coverage supports professional AppSec knowledge and aligns with the stored professional hint. The two-year profile and absence of a coding practical leave independent remediation and review delivery less certain.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded defensive application-security focus is valuable, but the two-year profile and open-book knowledge assessment do not demonstrate implementation delivery. I place it at associate rather than infer professional capability from accreditation alone.
